description: Myanmar military (Tatmadaw) seized power on February 1, 2021, detaining elected NLD officials including Aung San Suu Kyi and declaring a year-long state of emergency. The coup ended a decade of partial democratic transition. Subsequent months saw widespread protests, mass detentions, and a junta crackdown that killed thousands and effectively dismantled the elected legislature.

events.title: Myanmar: Military coup ends decade of democratic transition
events.body: Myanmar's military seized power on February 1, 2021, detaining elected officials including State Counsellor Aung San Suu Kyi and President Win Myint, and declaring a one-year state of emergency. The coup followed a November 2020 election in which the NLD won decisively. Human Rights Watch called the takeover an unconstitutional seizure of power.

events.title: Myanmar: Coup d'état and dissolution of elected parliament
events.body: The Tatmadaw's seizure of power dissolved the elected Pyidaungsu Hluttaw and replaced civilian governance with a State Administration Council headed by Min Aung Hlaing. The action overrides constitutional electoral provisions.

events.title: Myanmar: Multiple journalists arrested, internet shutdown imposed
events.body: Reporters Without Borders documented arrests of more than a dozen journalists across Yangon and Mandalay; the junta has imposed multiple nationwide internet shutdowns to suppress reporting on protests.

events.title: Myanmar: Security forces kill protesters in deadliest day yet
events.body: At least 38 protesters killed by security forces on March 3 alone in coordinated nationwide crackdowns, bringing the post-coup death toll to over 60. Human Rights Watch documents systematic use of live ammunition against civilians.

events.title: Myanmar: Junta dissolves NLD party in show trial
events.body: The Union Election Commission, controlled by the junta, dissolved the National League for Democracy and barred elected officials from future participation. Amnesty International called this a comprehensive disenfranchisement of the 2020 election outcome.

events.title: Myanmar: Junta sentences journalists in show trials
events.body: Special tribunals convicted multiple journalists under the Penal Code's incitement provisions, with sentences of 3–7 years. The trials lacked due process protections including access to defense counsel.
